description: Current property listings from the RE/MAX Lux feed, filterable by sale/rent, locality, price, bedrooms and MPRP threshold eligibility.

listing_type.description: For sale or to rent (both when omitted).

locality.description: Locality name, e.g. Sliema, St Julian's, Mellieħa.

max_price.description: Maximum price in EUR (annual rent for rentals).

min_price.description: Minimum price in EUR (annual rent for rentals).

mprp_eligible.description: Only listings priced at or above the MPRP minimum (purchase or annual rent).

property_type.description: apartment, penthouse, maisonette, townhouse, villa, farmhouse, …

query.description: Free-text words matched against title, description and locality.

special_designated_area.description: Only Special Designated Area developments (no AIP permit needed for non-residents).
